Description: -
Visa Corporate Business Systems (Visa CBS) is responsible for development and support of Hyperion applications that are used for cost center expense forecasting, and for management reporting and analysis. The Visa Hyperion environment includes 2 Planning applications used for expense forecasting, 3 Essbase ASO cubes used for management reporting and analysis, 1 DRM application used for metadata processing, and 1 FDM application used for data loads. The current version of Visa Hyperion applications is 11.1.2.0.
Responsibilities: -
Led analysis and implementation of Driver Tree-based forecasting models for OPEX planning across Personnel, Marketing, Professional Fees, Travel, Card Benefits, Network & Processing, D&A, and Other G&A expense categories
Collaborated with FP&A, Planning CoE, Business Finance Partners, People Team, and SMEs to define forecasting methodologies and business requirements for Oracle EPM implementation.
Supported design and delivery of PID-level workforce forecasting using Workday and Fieldglass integrations, enabling automated headcount, salary, incentive, and fringe benefit planning.
Worked on data integration and reconciliation across multiple enterprise systems including Workday, GIFS, GPC, CoStar, Fixed Assets, Hyperion, and Oracle EPM to establish a single source of truth for financial planning.
Participated in Key Design Decision (KDD) workshops and governance reviews, helping define planning dimensions, forecasting granularity, and future-state financial planning architecture.
Developed and validated driver-based forecasting logic, baseline seeding methodologies, and automated forecast calculations to improve planning accuracy and reduce manual effort.
Performed functional testing, data reconciliation, and cross-module integration testing to ensure accuracy of workforce, OPEX, capital, reporting, and project planning modules.
Partnered with business stakeholders to analyze forecast variances, validate assumptions, and incorporate business-driven adjustments into financial planning cycles.
Supported User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect management, and change adoption activities for global FP&A and regional finance teams.
Contributed to migration from legacy planning platforms (Hyperion/TM1) to Oracle EPM, improving reporting automation, data governance, and forecast consolidation capabilities.

Description:-
Deutsche Bank is a leading global investment bank with a strong and profitable private clients franchise. A leader in Germany and Europe, the Bank is continuously growing in North America, Asia and key emerging markets. DART stands for Dash Board Analysis Reporting Tool. DART application consists of monthly revenue data, ost data and head count data. DART application caters efficient budget and forecast process for the Deutsche bank by using Hyperion planning features. This application different budget and forecast models to serve the banks requirements.
DART Planning is Corporate Banking and Securities (CB&S) Budgeting and Forecasting application. Initially a Planning tool for Global Markets, it has evolved over years to cater for entire CB&S budgeting and forecasting requirements. Primary user base comprised of CB&S Finance/Central based out of UK and Mumbai (India). DB can do Monthly and Quarterly, year based plans are using for cost and revenue submissions.
